name: doses
description: Taking the medicine, at its time: every dose taken (health.medication.dose) as a log, so an occasional or as-needed medicine reads back without standing as a regimen, every dose missed (health.medication.dose-missed), and the compliance reports (health.medication.compliance). The meds projection is the current regimen; this is what was actually taken, and what was not. Version 4 adds health.medication.dose-missed and health.medication.compliance to version 3's dose. Version 3 named the same type as version 2 and only reworded this description. Version 2 named the type with its third segment; version 1 named it health.medication-dose.
